title: Volcanoes of Indonesia (streak)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Indonesia, one after another. Three markers too far from the place end the run, so aim with care. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Mountain Kendang
rounds.fact: Mountain Kendang is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 2,608 m in the source data. The data places it in Indonesia.

rounds.name: Mahawu
